workItems.title: Build persistent command-center Work Board
workItems.why: The command center cannot be useful if tasks live only in chat or static page sections.
workItems.expectedImpact: Creates one place for backlog, this week, in-progress, blocked, approval-needed, and done work.
workItems.proofRequired: Work Board renders from JSON-backed command state and exposes task lane, priority, owner, proof, links, and status. Local typecheck, lint, build, and route checks passed.
workItems.metricToWatch: Whether future cron/operator runs pull from the board instead of inventing new work.

workItems.title: Run true AI visibility baseline
workItems.why: AI visibility cannot be managed from guesses or one Google manual check.
workItems.expectedImpact: Creates a repeatable comparison floor for ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI surfaces.
workItems.proofRequired: Prompt, engine, 247ROI presence, competitors cited, cited domains, absence notes, and next fix stored in the AI Visibility Pipeline.
workItems.dueOrCadence: First baseline, then monthly if useful
workItems.metricToWatch: Number of tracked prompts where 247ROI appears or where cited-source gaps are clear.

workItems.title: Prepare Google Business Profile and LinkedIn company copy
workItems.why: Authority work requires legitimate public profiles, but submissions should not happen without approval.
workItems.expectedImpact: Moves authority from research into controlled execution without risky outreach or unapproved claims.
workItems.proofRequired: Draft fields, required assets, approval request, and no public submission until B approves.
workItems.metricToWatch: Completed approved profiles and live third-party entity signals.

workItems.title: Baseline commercial pages with no GSC rows
workItems.why: Important offer pages may be live but invisible, too new, or under-supported internally.
workItems.expectedImpact: Focuses internal links and content updates only on pages that need support.
workItems.proofRequired: Tracked URL, target query, GSC row status, manual index/rank check, and next action.
workItems.metricToWatch: GSC impressions and average position for priority offer pages.

workItems.title: Compare AI employees page after recrawl
workItems.why: The page was tuned from GSC evidence and needs enough crawl delay before judging movement.
workItems.expectedImpact: Shows whether the page update improved a real query cluster.
workItems.metricToWatch: Impressions, clicks, average position, and landing page match.

workItems.title: Build one workflow teardown proof asset
workItems.why: The site needs concrete proof without inventing client claims.
workItems.expectedImpact: Gives visitors, partners, and AI/search systems a specific artifact to understand 247ROI's work.
workItems.proofRequired: Public proof page or asset with problem, system shape, approval points, measurable outcome, and audit CTA.
workItems.metricToWatch: Page views, internal clicks to audit, and reuse in warm outreach.

workItems.title: Hold broad conversion redesigns
workItems.why: Traffic and contact events are too low to infer conversion friction reliably.
workItems.expectedImpact: Prevents redesign churn from weak data.
workItems.proofRequired: Enough qualified traffic, audit completions/unlocks, contact clicks, or direct sales feedback.
workItems.metricToWatch: Audit starts, unlocks, CTA clicks, call clicks, email clicks, and lead quality.

automation.lastOutput: Stored first verifiable visibility baseline and authority target batch.
automation.nextPlannedWork: Pull from active Work Board items; likely AI visibility baseline or authority approval drafts.
automation.retireRule: Retire or pause if it reports without shipping, records stale status, or creates work outside the board.

automation.name: 247ROI Weekly Growth Report
automation.purpose: Summarize shipped work, verification, production status, blockers, and next week's focus.
automation.lastOutput: Reported prior shipped work and next focus before the command-center redesign push.
automation.nextPlannedWork: Report from Work Board, Done Ledger, metrics, and decisions.
automation.retireRule: Retire if it becomes a narrative summary instead of a board/metric delta.
